scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from an explicit two-sided Weyl-unitary factorization and a geometric diagonal operator. Finite matrix checks are supplementary, not a proof. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly contractive affine unweighted composition symbols on the one-dimensional standard Gaussian Fock space. Spectra other than singular values, nonlinear maps, boundary-slope noncompact regimes, and higher dimensions are not classified. Earlier equivalent Gaussian-kernel/Weyl formulations may exist outside the inspected sources.
title: Exact two-order singular spectra and displacement reversal for affine Fock composition products
